definition.title: Reference people and groups

blocks.text: 您 is polite singular you; 它 refers to a nonhuman referent. 们 forms plural personal pronouns. Omit a subject only when it is clear from context. When the subject is unambiguous in a reply, Mandarin often omits it instead of repeating the pronoun.
